title: Send search
searchPlaceholder: Name, email or mobile of an agent or supervisor…
includeOverOneYear: Include sends older than one year (the search will take longer)

tooltip.recorded: The version was recorded at the moment of the send — this is the version that was actually sent.
tooltip.inferred: There is no send record for the version, but the mapping has not been changed since the send — so this is the version that was sent.
tooltip.unverifiable: The mapping was changed after the send — which version was sent cannot be established with certainty.

drawer.rowValues: The values sent to this recipient
drawer.noRowValues: No source row was sent for this recipient — the tokens were sent empty
drawer.coverageCaveat: These are counts, not percentages: email has no delivery receipt, SMS has no open metric, and a recipient may have been reached on more than one channel — so the denominator differs per channel.
drawer.rosterReconstructed: This recipient list is reconstructed from the current mapping and is not a record of who was actually sent to.

footnote.tracking: Open and click data come from tracking and are not available on every channel; no recorded activity is not proof the message went unseen.

error.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to view recipient details

preview.title: The email that was sent
preview.disabled: The email cannot be shown: the server supplied no preview link for this row (a non-email channel, or a missing recipient or campaign id).
preview.noTrackNote: This preview is not recorded as an open by the recipient, and the links inside it are disabled.

adv.unavailable: There are currently no fields available to filter by
adv.incomplete: Missing a value — this filter is not applied
adv.partialWarning: This field does not exist in every campaign in the results. Filtering by it will return no rows from the campaigns that lack it.

empty.title: There are no fields to filter by
empty.body: Filterable fields are defined on the Data Sources screen: mark a column as searchable in the source settings and it will appear here on the next send.

sort.label: Sort by
sort.hiddenFieldNote: The sort uses a field that is not a column of the grid. Each row's sort value is shown in the "Sort value" column.
